names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru’s name page 9642, «Иоанн (Спасский), иерей, сщмч.», with the two rank words after the comma left off. The day’s own line gives the forename only — «Сщмч. Иоанна пресвитера (1941).» — so the surname is read off the name link, where the calendar prints it, and it is part of the name and stays. Measured against the gate’s own key function before it was written: 'иоанн спасскии' has no other holder in the corpus, where the bare «Иоанн» has very many; `sergius-spassky` is the only folder holding this surname and it is a different forename on a different day.

death.note: The year the day line prints for him: «Сщмч. Иоанна пресвитера (1941).» No year of birth appears on the name page, which is all the calendar gives him, and none was inferred.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 27 апреля ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Иоанна пресвитера (1941).»

attestations.note: The day’s sixth entry of eight, and the whole of it. THE CALENDAR GIVES NO LIFE: the line links no reading and page 9642 prints the title «Иоанн (Спасский), иерей, сщмч.» and «Дни памяти: 26 января (Новомуч.) , 27 апреля» and nothing else at all. What it gives that the line does not is the surname «Спасский» and the grade «иерей», priest, written out beside «сщмч.»; the line gives «пресвитера». 26 января is the general commemoration of the new martyrs and confessors, which is how `new-martyr` is read into `types`, and THAT DAY PAGE WAS NOT READ. HE IS NOT THE OTHER JOHN OF THIS DAY: the fourth entry’s «Иоанн (Рождественский)», name page 9630, is a different surname, a different year (1922) and a separate folder of batch ru-04-27-1, and this calendar’s own practice of a distinct name page with a distinct year is what keeps the two apart. NO FOLDER WAS FOUND FOR HIM: `grep -rl 'Спасский'` over `saints/` returns `sergius-spassky`, a different forename on another day, and the gate’s own key function returns no holder for 'иоанн спасскии' or 'john spassky'. NO PLACE, DIOCESE OR PARISH IS NAMED ANYWHERE on either page. The day page prints nine hymns, three under the name of the kinsman of the Lord and six under the name of the abbot of the Caves, and none under his. azbyka.ru was not read.
